Your words. Your website.

Create & publish

Write a story, share a Field Note or add a travel fact. You control what goes online.

After a new story is actually published, Pinterest preparation appears as a private calendar task. Images stay in your OneDrive; you schedule the Pins yourself. Open Pinterest planning.

Sign in to open your publishing desk.

Your entries

Drafts stay private. Published entries are visible on your website.

Story heading & travel period Optional

Only name a place you are ready to share publicly.

Reading time is calculated automatically at approximately 200 words per minute.

Add a chapter

Each line starting with ## becomes a chapter, with its own menu link. Write the chapter text underneath. Up to 24 chapters.

Add a Did you know? card

Use a real fact you have checked and a full HTTPS source link.

Formatting help

Leave an empty line between paragraphs. Start a heading with ##. Use **bold words**, - for list items, or [link text](https://example.com). HTML is treated as text.

Photographs, cover & banner

Add up to 12 photos. They are resized on your device before upload; original files and location metadata are not uploaded. The first photo is the cover on the Stories/Field Notes overview. Choose its position in the story below each photo.

The banner crop is separate from the gallery. Gallery photos retain their full frame. Check both desktop and mobile previews before publishing.

Film & sources Optional

Films open only when a visitor chooses to watch. Large video files are not uploaded here.

You can save unfinished text as a private draft. Complete the title, introduction and story before previewing and publishing.

Restore a downloaded backup

Restores a new private copy in this form. Nothing is saved or published until you choose to do so.

Website preview · nothing is published
Publish later

Preview and confirm the exact version before scheduling. It appears in your private calendar immediately. The free background planner may be delayed; your computer can be off. Editing a draft keeps the scheduled version separate until you reschedule it.

No website publication scheduled.

Publishing does not send a newsletter. Use Postcards to manage emails separately.

Opens an editable email from the published or scheduled version. For a scheduled story, its linked Postcard waits until the story is online. You must separately preview and approve its delivery.

Delete this entry

Removes the saved draft, its website publication and website schedule. Private saved versions and media remain in backups; this does not cancel campaigns already in Brevo.
